data.content_ref: inline:conn:204d29004328 INTEGRATES the enumeration strategy of SRC_005 with the algebraic guarantee of SRC_004: enumeration from the sparser residue class (mod 7) is a constructive search whose termination is guaranteed by CRT's uniqueness theorem (gcd(5,7)=1 ⟹ unique mod 35). The integration is that CRT provides the proof of correctness (exactly one solution class mod 35 exists) while enumeration provides the discovery procedure (find the smallest positive element). This integration is REFUTED IF CRT's uniqueness guarantee is insufficient to bound the enumeration—i.e., if the search could miss the solution despite uniqueness, or if gcd(5,7)≠1 making the solution class non-unique.
